target_fidelity.note: It is a positive present progressive passive declarative with no modal.

grammaticality.note: The target answer is grammatical English.

naturalness.note: The prompt and answer form a coherent description of an ongoing action.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice of the present progressive passive.

determinacy.note: The context and cues sufficiently specify the intended response.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary is common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt supplies cues but does not display the completed target form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Only the target passive progressive construction is needed.

no_world_knowledge.note: No external or specialist knowledge is required.
